# Bible Study Tools

> > A comprehensive online platform for studying Scripture across 30+ Bible translations with commentaries, concordances, and original language resources.

Bible Study Tools provides free and premium access to multiple Bible versions (KJV, ESV, NIV, NASB, NLT, The Message), study plans, and scholarly reference materials including commentaries, lexicons, and interlinear texts. The platform serves both casual readers and serious biblical scholars with tools for verse comparison, topical searches, and deep linguistic analysis of original Greek and Hebrew texts.

## Key Topics

- Bible translations
- King James Version (KJV)
- English Standard Version (ESV)
- New International Version (NIV)
- New American Standard Bible (NASB)
- Old Testament
- New Testament
- Scripture study
- Greek and Hebrew
- Bible commentaries
- Concordances
- Interlinear Bible
- Topical verses
- Bible reading plans
- Strong's Concordance

## Bible Versions & Translations

- [Bible Versions and Translations Online](https://www.biblestudytools.com/bible-versions): Access 30+ Bible translations including KJV, ESV, NASB, and NIV
- [Compare Bible Translations: Read All Versions Side by Side](https://www.biblestudytools.com/compare-translations): Read all Bible translations side-by-side including NIV, KJV, ESV, The Message
- [Online Parallel Bible - Compare Bible Verse Translations](https://www.biblestudytools.com/parallel-bible): Compare Bible verses side-by-side across KJV, NIV, ESV, and other versions
- [Audio Bible: Listen Online for Free](https://www.biblestudytools.com/audio-bible): Free audio Bible in KJV, ESV, and NLT translations for listening

## Core Study Tools

- [Online Bible Study Tools – Library of Resources](https://www.biblestudytools.com/library): Central library of commentaries, concordances, dictionaries, and reference tools
- [Books of the Bible - Full List Order of Old and New Testament](https://www.biblestudytools.com/books-of-the-bible): Browse Old and New Testament books with summaries in 50+ translations
- [Bible Verses by Topic - Search Scripture Topics](https://www.biblestudytools.com/topical-verses): Search Scripture by topic for encouragement, faith, and spiritual guidance
- [Bible Reading Plans for 2026 - Read the Bible in a Year](https://www.biblestudytools.com/bible-reading-plan): 20+ daily Bible reading plans with chronological and thematic options

## Reference & Commentary Tools

- [25+ Bible Commentaries to Study God's Word Online](https://www.biblestudytools.com/commentaries): 25+ Bible commentaries by theologians for verse-by-verse biblical interpretation
- [The Interlinear Bible: Study the Original Greek & Hebrew Text](https://www.biblestudytools.com/interlinear-bible): Study original Greek and Hebrew with Strong's Concordance references
- [Greek and Hebrew Lexicons - Original Bible Word Meanings](https://www.biblestudytools.com/lexicons): Greek and Hebrew lexicons with original biblical word meanings and definitions
- [Bible Concordances - Use Free Online](https://www.biblestudytools.com/concordances): Strong's, Torrey's, Nave's concordances for word lookup and cross-references

## Biblical Reference Materials

- [Bible Dictionary - Online Dictionaries](https://www.biblestudytools.com/dictionaries): Bible dictionaries including Easton's and Smith's for word definitions and origins
- [Bible Encyclopedia and Bible Study Tools](https://www.biblestudytools.com/encyclopedias): Bible encyclopedia with biblical terms, characters, and scripture definitions
- [Apocrypha - Old Testament Bible History](https://www.biblestudytools.com/apocrypha): Apocrypha and Deuterocanonical books with Septuagint translations

## Premium & Membership

- [PLUS - Bible Study Tools](https://www.biblestudytools.com/plus): Premium membership offering commentaries, study Bibles, and exclusive content
